en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I think I'm regretting this
a little bit...

<CLT=cltMIND>I want to ask my past self why he thought
it was a good idea to hang out with Tenko.
Gaarrgghh...!
Grrrrrrrrrrr...!
HIIIIIIIIIISSSSSSSS!!!

Give me a reaction already!
I don't know what else to do!
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh, *you* don't know what to do?
Tenko...what are you trying to do?

I'm intimidating you!
GRRRRRRRRRRR!!!
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah. That's what I thought.

Why are you trying so hard
to intimidate me?
Because you're a degenerate male!

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of honesty is
certainly refreshing.

What were you thinking inviting me
to hang out with you!?
Wait actually, I already know!

You're trying to get rid of me first, so you
can sexually harrass the other girls!

Ah, no, I don't think so...
Why do you hate men so much, Tenko?
<CLT=cltMIND>It was a simple enough question...
Why, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Little did I know what wrath
I had brought upon myself!

Of course, you males wouldn't know!
You're the worst, lowest, most evil scum!
Ah!

Degenerates always need a reason for
everything, don't they!?

And you don't even know why you're scum
because you don't criticize yourself!
Master said so, too!

As long as there are selfish males,
I will never master Neo-Aikido!
What kind of logic is that!?

A-Are you asking questions like that to get
closer to me!?

As I thought... There are no pros to males
other than they are born from women!

Can't you see I'm looking at you in disgust!?
But you're still coming closer to me!

Why, God, why!?
Why would you create degenerate males!?

Girls would be able to live in peace if you
degenerates disappeared from this world!

*gasp*! I knew it! Males are actually
created by the devil, right!?
Calm down!
I-I'm...sorry?
Just shut up for a minute!
Are you unsure of something?
T-Tenko!

Calm down!
I have no idea what you're talking about!

I *am* calm!
Upset, but still calm!
You don't *seem* very calm.

It may not seem like it to a degenerate,
but I'm super duper calm for a girl!

<CLT=cltMIND>This conversation is
going nowhere...
I-I'm...sorry?

Wh-Why are degenerate males so...! Do you
think you can fix it just by apologizing!?
Such cowardice! I won't allow it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, that had the
opposite effect!

Just shut up for a minute!
You're going to cause trouble!
Wh-Wh-Wh-Whaaat!? Is that an order!?

If you're gonna take away my freedom of
speech, then I'll protest against you!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wasn't trying to
order you around!

Ah, wait, wait, wait!
Just...calm down a minute.

<CLT=cltMIND>And this is where I made my
second mistake. I grabbed her shoulder...

Just like a degenerate male...
I knew you'd try to touch me...
...What?
HAAAIIIYAAAAAHHH!!!!!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*slam*!

OW!!!
Wh-Why did you throw me!?

AAAAHHHH!!!!!
You just touched me, didn't you!?

Touch you!? You touched *me*
when you threw me!
Yeah! Which is technically touching me!
What!?
HAAAIIIYAAAAAHHH!!!!!
Aaugh!!!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tenko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I was thrown several more times, blacked
out, and then woke up on my bed.

<CLT=cltMIND>What happened...?
Did Tenko carry me here?
